entries.title: A crewmate's summary opens even when a card changes as the app starts
entries.body: If a card arrived or closed while the app was still loading your tasks, pointing at a crewmate could show no summary until a task changed. The summary now opens as soon as your tasks have loaded.
entries.noPicture: The summary looks as it did; the fix is that it now opens where it stayed hidden, which one still picture cannot tell apart from before.
